notes:

'Quest Reqs: Job level 75+' is the level gate restated for any job, so level is 75 and jobs stays empty; 'Adventuring Fellow level 66+' has no slot and no observable predicate, so it is flagged and gates nothing. The header's Item Reqs '[KI] Magian trial log' never appears in the walkthrough but is what lets you register a Magian trial at all, so it rides on step 3 as a held item rather than becoming a rung of its own. Step 1's [KI] Magian Mooglehood missive is recorded as evidence even though the resolver rejects the name as non-unique across res/key_items -- writing it keeps the reading auditable and stage C will drop just that entry. The Tandem Necklace is handed back after each trade, so it is evidence on step 2 ONLY; making it evidence again at step 5 would jump the mark. Step 4 is thirty kills of no named monster with a Fellow out -- a real rung, but nothing in the packets counts it, hence no mobs and no evidence. The page names the same moogle two ways: plain 'Magian Moogle' for the giver at (H-5) and 'Magian Moogle (Blue)' for the trial registrar at the same grid; both are written as the page writes them and both fold to the same key.

notes:
Six telepoints in any order, so they share a group and all six draw at once. The important negative decision is evidence. Each crystal grants a key item of exactly the same name -- Dem/Holla/Mea/Yhoator/Altepa/Vahzl gate crystal, all six of which resolve cleanly -- and it is very tempting to hang them on the six steps. That would be WRONG, and the page says so itself: 'If you have previously gotten all of the gate key crystals, you must do all six again.' The key items are permanent and most players already hold them, so evidence would mark all six done the moment the quest opened. Every crystal step therefore carries evidence null. The other loss is zones: the page names the six crystals and no zone for any of them, and rule one forbids supplying Konschtat, La Theine and the rest from memory, so all six rows are zone-less. Their names are distinctive enough that a nil-zone row should still match only the right entity. Bullet 2 is Nantoto restating the request and merges into step 1; bullet 4 is an outcome (sparks and experience) and is not a rung. The RoE objective 'Telepoint Pilgrimage' must be switched on under Other -> RoE Quests BEFORE any crystal is touched -- a menu action with no marker, kept as a note on step 1. 'Must have 50 unique RoE objectives completed' has no slot in the schema and nothing observable behind it.

notes: Straightforward ladder with one conflict and one shape worth being deliberate about. The header puts Behsa Alehgo at Eastern Adoulin (J-8) and bullet 1 puts him at (J-7); both are kept where each was written -- the header string in start, the walkthrough's grid on the step -- rather than reconciled. The shape is three visits to the SAME Suspicious Place at Yorcia Weald (I-8) with a fight in the middle, and bullet 5 packs the fight's aftermath and the third click into one sentence, so it splits. All four of those rungs sit on one entity and the runtime collapses them to a single marker, which is exactly right: the player stands in one grove the whole time. Erfimia is named only in the description and is never a targetable entity, so she is nowhere in the ladder -- bullet 2 is entering Celennia Memorial Library, and that zone is the target. Nothing in this quest is observable: the Homiliary, the experience and the Bayld are all Reward, and rule seven keeps rewards out of evidence. Bullet 4's sub-bullets are a mob profile (70,000 HP, Cruel Joke around 25 percent, Kaustra, Dread Spikes, Frazzle III, Endark) and stay a note. 'Pool of Clarity Ergon Locus' is the place; 'Pellucid Afflusion' is the thing you click, so that is the target.
